digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, LLM step failure reporting
propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures are invisible in plan-review verdict JSON because they are swallowed and logged only as warnings without a counter in the coverage object.
The plan-review verdict has no field to surface survived LLM failures; coverage.resolution_class fires only on fatal degrades and coverage.chunk_errors is write-only with no reader.
All failed LLM calls funnel through a single seam at PydanticAIRunner.run except block (runner.py:573) where spend is logged but no in-memory counter is maintained for the verdict.

A run-scoped contextvars sink must record LLM failures at the runner seam, be activated during plan-review gate dispatch, and drained into a new coverage.llm_step_failures field shaped as {total, by_step} keyed by _call_label.
Clean runs (no LLM failures) must not include the llm_step_failures key in the verdict to remain byte-identical and attestation-safe.
The failure count must not alter the verdict string, exit code, signature, or provenance stamp; all existing swallow behavior and retry logic remain unchanged.
